item.observed: Every CPF in a city sees the same three fixed invoices, including when it has no debt.
item.title: Consumers see invented debts instead of their own invoices — the public lookup renders three hardcoded 2026 rows for every CPF and never queries stored invoices

item.observed: A 503 or network error shows a QR code for the example PIX key instead of an error.
item.title: Customers can be directed to pay a fictitious PIX recipient when generation fails — the public page replaces every backend or network error with a hardcoded fallback code

item.observed: A rejected clipboard write still records PIX copiado and shows 'Pix copiado!'.
item.title: The copied-PIX card increases even when the customer never copies — the page records the event before clipboard success and reports failed copies as successful

item.observed: Home clicks display 'Cidade não informada' even after the visitor selects a city.
item.title: The admin cannot identify visitors' cities in the requested clicks modal — the home access request never supplies the city that the backend stores

item.observed: With zero checked invoices Continue generates a PIX for all three, not a warning.
item.title: Visitors who select no invoices are prompted to pay all three — Continue falls back to every row when the selection is empty

item.observed: Any positive supplied valor becomes a generated PIX and increases the KPI by that value.
item.title: The operator's generated-payment total can be fabricated by anyone — the public generation route trusts the caller's amount and months without looking up invoices

item.observed: Copying the same PIX twice increases the total only on the first copy.
item.title: The copied-PIX card misses repeated successful copies — the server stores a single boolean per invoice instead of a copy event for each actual copy

item.observed: A PIX generated yesterday and copied today adds R$ 0,00 to 'copiados hoje'.
item.title: Admin sees PIX copied today as zero when yesterday's PIX is copied today — the today aggregation filters invoice creation time rather than copy time

item.observed: A short client code passes the form, gets HTTP 400 on generation and displays fallback PIX.
item.title: Customers using Código do cliente get a substitute PIX instead of a valid payment — the client accepts any nonempty code but generation only accepts an 11- or 14-digit document

item.observed: The modal displays only the newest 100 clicks even when the card reports more.
item.title: The admin loses the click details when the modal has more than 100 visits — the modal requests only 100 and neither it nor the endpoint provides a next page

item.observed: Tab cannot focus the home-click card and Enter cannot open its details.
item.title: Keyboard-only admins cannot open the requested clicks modal — the clickable KPI is a nonfocusable div with only an onClick handler

item.observed: A failed overview request shows R$ 0,00 and 0 with no error or retry.
item.title: Admin cannot tell that the dashboard is offline and sees zero or stale totals — overview errors are swallowed and missing data defaults to zero

item.observed: If the click insert fails, the card rises but no click row is stored.
item.title: Home-click count can exceed the modal's real visits — the public endpoint increments its counter before the click insert without a transaction

item.observed: Changing a city price in settings leaves the public invoice prices unchanged.
item.title: The admin's saved city prices never change the invoices customers see — the live public page uses its own fixed city price table and never reads settings

item.observed: Generation accepts an empty meses list and any positive amount without invoice ownership checks.
item.title: Customers cannot safely pay invoices generated for the wrong amount or owner — generation accepts arbitrary client-supplied values and no invoice identifiers

item.observed: GET /api/dashboard/stats has no registered route.
item.title: Admin integrations requesting the specified stats endpoint get 404 — the server only declares /dashboard/overview

item.observed: The count can exceed 200 while only the newest 200 invoices are reachable.
item.title: Admins cannot see all generated invoices after 200 records — the list requests a fixed limit with no pagination or way to reach older rows

item.observed: Any positive supplied valor becomes a generated PIX and increases the KPI by that value.
item.title: The operator's generated-payment total can be fabricated and customers charged an unrelated amount — the public generation route trusts the caller's amount and months without looking up invoice IDs or ownership

reason: Same missing invoice lookup and trusted client amount already reported in R-BUG-006.

item.observed: A generated invoice stays pendente; no payment-confirmation handler sets pago.
item.title: Customers are told their debt will be cleared automatically but paid invoices stay pending — the static PIX flow has no payment confirmation or invoice settlement integration

item.observed: Replaying one /public/gerar request inserts a second invoice and doubles its KPI amount.
item.title: Admins see generated-payment totals doubled after a retried submission — the endpoint stores session_id but never uses an idempotency key or deduplicates requests

item.observed: A successful clipboard copy with a failed event request leaves the copied KPI unchanged.
item.title: Admin misses real PIX copies when the copy-event request fails — the public page drops the error without retry or reconciliation

item.observed: A failed clicks request shows 'Nenhum clique registrado ainda.'
item.title: Admin sees a false empty clicks modal when the click history fails to load — the fetch catch turns every error into an empty list

item.observed: Saving while settings fail to load overwrites the stored PIX key and other settings with defaults.
item.title: Admin can accidentally erase the payment key and disable payments — settings starts with blanks, ignores load errors and every save replaces the entire document

item.observed: A signed-out session's JWT remains accepted until its seven-day expiration.
item.title: An exposed admin session can still read and change payment settings after sign-out — logout only deletes local storage and the server checks no revocation state

item.observed: A token expiring while the panel is open leaves the dashboard showing stale data.
item.title: Admin is not returned to sign-in when a session expires during use — only the initial /auth/me request handles 401 and the API client has no response interceptor

item.observed: Settings has no password change and POST /api/auth/password-change is absent.
item.title: The admin cannot rotate the supplied password from the panel — neither settings nor the auth API implements password change

item.observed: The sign-in form offers no forgotten-password or reset flow.
item.title: An admin who forgets the password cannot recover access from sign-in — no reset request, expiring token or reset page is implemented

item.observed: POST /api/auth/login accepts unlimited consecutive password attempts.
item.title: The admin account and payment settings are exposed to automated password guessing — the public login route has no attempt limit or lockout

item.observed: At 21:00 in Brasília, 'hoje' already counts the next UTC day.
item.title: Brazilian admins see today's payment and click totals roll over three hours early — day boundaries use UTC midnight rather than the displayed local timezone

item.observed: The seven-day 'Pagamentos' chart includes pending generated PIX, not confirmed payments.
item.title: Admins can mistake generated PIX amounts for money paid — the payments chart sums every invoice irrespective of settlement

item.observed: Settings accepts negative city values, malformed PIX keys and arbitrary key types.
item.title: Admins can save invalid payment settings that create unusable or wrong PIX codes — settings has no server-side key, type, city or amount validation

item.observed: Telegram non-2xx replies and request exceptions do not reach the admin.
item.title: Admins silently miss configured Telegram activity alerts — notify_telegram ignores provider error responses and only logs connection failures

item.observed: Missing clicks compound index: (page ASC, created_at DESC).
item.title: The requested clicks modal slows as visits accumulate — its page filter and newest-first sort have no clicks index

item.observed: Missing faturas index for pix_copiado and created_at; the KPI repeats every 2 seconds.
item.title: The dashboard slows as generated invoices grow — copied-PIX aggregations repeatedly scan faturas without a pix_copiado/created_at index

item.observed: Missing faturas index on documento; every CPF search uses a regex scan.
item.title: Admins' invoice searches slow with growing history — the documento search has no supporting index and runs again for each typed query

item.observed: Calling /public/consulta inserts a new fatura and increases the generated-value KPI.
item.title: Admin's generated-payment total can grow at lookup before any invoice is selected — the public consulta endpoint creates a PIX and records it as generated

item.observed: Only 60 activities are reachable and older events are deleted after 500.
item.title: Admins lose their older public activity history — activity writes delete all but 500 records and the activity page has no pagination beyond 60

item.observed: A failed invoices or activity request is presented as an empty or waiting list.
item.title: Admins cannot distinguish missing invoices or activities from a server failure — both panel pages swallow request errors and show empty states

item.observed: A slow response to an older search can replace newer search results.
item.title: Admins can see invoices for the wrong search or status — overlapping list requests update state without checking which filter is current

item.observed: A successful empty recent-payments list displays 'Carregando...' indefinitely.
item.title: New admins see recent payments loading forever despite a successful empty result — the dashboard uses the same placeholder for zero rows and loading

item.observed: The clicks modal does not close on Escape or trap and restore keyboard focus.
item.title: Keyboard users cannot safely navigate or dismiss the clicks dialog — the custom overlay omits dialog semantics, focus management and Escape handling

item.observed: A city row requires a text input, a 144px amount field and a 44px delete control in one row.
item.title: Admins editing city prices on narrow phones can lose access to row controls — the unwrapped flex row retains fixed-width amount and delete controls

item.observed: Dashboard offers no date range; overview and click listing accept no from/to parameters.
item.title: Admins cannot compare dashboard metrics over a selected period — the dashboard and its data routes have no date-range filter

item.observed: Invoices have no due date or sort control, and status filters reset on reload.
item.title: Admins cannot review or sort invoices by due date or amount — invoice data and the list expose neither due dates nor sorting and do not persist filters

item.observed: If the API is on a different host, public requests go to the frontend origin instead.
item.title: Public payment and click tracking fail in split-host deployments — the HTML hardcodes relative /api while the panel uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL

item.observed: An in-flight /auth/me response can set user again after logout clears it.
item.title: Admin can appear signed in again immediately after signing out — the pending session revalidation repopulates user state after logout

item.observed: After switching from a valid CPF to client-code mode, generation still submits the old CPF.
item.title: Customers changing lookup mode generate records for the previous CPF instead of the client code — documento() reads the hidden CPF field first

item.observed: Any nonempty city text enables Continue and unknown cities use the default invoice values.
item.title: Customers who mistype or do not select a city see default debts for the wrong location — city validation tests only for nonempty text

item.observed: The panel's Copiar código PIX succeeds without recording a copy event.
item.title: Copies made from the invoice panel never appear in copied-PIX activity — the panel's copy buttons only write to the clipboard

item.observed: An existing donas record retains its old password even when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
item.title: An admin with an existing account can remain locked out after the supplied password is configured — startup seeds the password only when the user does not already exist

item.observed: Entrar, Institucional, Serviços and Atendimento all point to #.
item.title: Public visitors cannot use the site's navigation or footer links — the displayed destinations all point to the current page's empty hash

item.observed: An enabled but unreachable Telegram server blocks the async event loop for up to 8 seconds.
item.title: A Telegram outage can stall other visitors and dashboard requests — synchronous requests.post runs inside async public handlers

item.observed: Concurrent first clicks after midnight can reset clicks_home_today more than once.
item.title: Admin's daily click count can lose visits at the day boundary — the date check and counter reset are separate nonconditional writes

item.observed: A password over 72 bytes can raise a bcrypt ValueError and cause a server error.
item.title: Admin sees a server error instead of a login rejection for an overlong password — bcrypt input is not bounded or handled

reason: The KPI is scoped to public-site activity; an admin copying in the panel need not count.
The pinned bcrypt 4.1.3 may truncate instead of raising; the claimed 500 is not supported.

item.observed: iOS Chrome and Firefox user agents are classified as Safari; Opera as Chrome.
item.title: Admins see the wrong browser for some visitors in click details — user-agent parsing recognizes desktop tokens but not CriOS, FxiOS or Opera

item.observed: New clicks update the card but do not appear in an already-open modal.
item.title: Admins monitoring the clicks modal miss new visitors until reopening it — the modal fetches only once while the dashboard refreshes

item.observed: A slower old /dashboard/overview response can replace newer KPI totals.
item.title: Admins can see live totals move backwards during slow requests — the two-second poll allows overlapping responses to overwrite newer data

item.observed: An activity insert failure after fatura insert returns an error but leaves the KPI increased.
item.title: Admin's generated total can increase even though no generated PIX reaches the customer — invoice and activity writes are not atomic and a later failure returns an error

item.observed: If activity insertion fails after the flag update, retry skips the missing copy event.
item.title: Admins can permanently lose a copied-PIX activity after a partial failure — the invoice flag is set before the activity write and retries skip it
